Never show the front, vertical side, upright facade, drawer fronts, tall backrest face, front legs or any elevation. All straight opposite edges remain perfectly parallel. Round tops are CIRCLES, never ellipses. This is a battlemap sprite, not an isometric or catalog product view. For a wagon show its open cargo or canvas ROOF from directly above; wheels appear as narrow side strips, never round side-view wheels. For gardening objects show top surfaces and plant foliage from straight above; tools lie flat. Realistic hand-painted medieval natural materials, crisp details, coherent human footprint 1 by 1 five-foot cells. Transparent alpha outside the complete object, tiny contact shadow only. No external ground, floor tile, room, people, background color, frame, grid, text, signature or watermark.
MANDATORY CAMERA CORRECTION: A scarecrow exactly overhead: a round straw hat crown in the center with two straight outstretched linen sleeve TOP surfaces extending left and right on a crossbar. Head, face and hanging long tunic are hidden directly below hat and shoulders. No full frontal body, no face, no vertical pole shaft. All seen from a strict overhead 90 degree camera with zero tilt.
